*   **Quadrant Cloud Deployment**: Hands-on demonstration and guidance on creating a cluster, obtaining API keys and endpoints, and connecting to Quadrant Cloud for vector storage [17 August 2026, Page 14-16 — Siddharth Saminathan].
*   **Context, Harness, and Prompt Engineering**: The importance of designing systems by first considering the harness, then context, and finally the prompt, with a focus on proper tool calls and defining roles/personas for agents [17 August 2026, Page 13-14 — Siddharth Saminathan].

Decisions
*   The Team Intelligence Agent needs to go beyond simple retrieval and infer patterns, evaluate performance, and generate comprehensive reports [17 August 2026, Page 2-4 — Siddharth Saminathan].
*   The RAG pipeline will be structured into three main systems: Vector Store, Retrieval Service, and Evaluation, with clear boundaries and API interfaces [17 August 2026, Page 7-8 — Siddharth Saminathan].
*   The knowledge base will include a "training profile" for each team member, updated daily, containing name, thinking style, assigned tasks, and evaluation scores [17 August 2026, Page 2-3 (30) — Siddharth Saminathan].
